commitment: The eight-seed estimate will be reported whatever it shows, including if it leaves the primary endpoint crossing zero, and including if it returns the endpoint to excluding zero. No further seed will be added on the basis of the eight-seed outcome.
inference_caveat: Because the decision to continue was conditional on the seven-seed outcome, the eight-seed interval does not carry its nominal coverage and no eight-seed p-value or interval may be reported as a confirmatory test. The eight-seed roster is an estimate, reported with this amendment disclosed alongside it.
primary_estimand: stochastic shuffled minus matched response MAE (unchanged)
reason: The author elected to add an eighth seed after seeing the seven-seed result. This is recorded as an outcome-informed amendment, not a pre-registered extension: unlike seeds 47-48, which were declared before any extension result existed and added symmetrically, seed 49 was chosen in response to where the seven-seed estimate landed.
reporting_rule: The frozen five-seed roster remains the registered result. Seven- and eight-seed estimates are reported alongside it, never in place of it.
what_was_known_when_this_was_declared: The complete seven-seed roster had already been analysed. The pre-registered primary endpoint (undisclosed, stochastic) fell from +0.0935 with a 95% Student-t interval of [+0.0407,+0.1464] at five seeds to +0.0756 with [-0.0025,+0.1538] at seven, and no longer excluded zero under any estimator. Seed 47 was the single negative seed (-0.091). Disclosed/greedy moved the other way and began excluding zero. It was also known that, if a further seed behaved like the current mean and standard deviation, n=8 would return the primary interval to excluding zero.
